root.title: Open Duck Mini v2
root.description: An open-source sixteen-joint biped presented as source-linked mechanical assemblies.

source.author: Antoine Pirrone / Open Duck Mini contributors; display adaptation by Annora
source.attribution: Open Duck Mini v2 · Antoine Pirrone and contributors · Apache-2.0. Display adaptation and authored motion: Annora, 2026.
source.description: An open-source sixteen-joint biped presented as source-linked mechanical assemblies.
source.note: Derived display geometry is simplified from pinned source STL files. Finishes, exploded offsets and pose animation are illustrative; not manufacturing data, learned walking or a physically balanced simulation.
